name: Mailercloud
description: Mailercloud is an email marketing platform for contacts, lists, campaigns, templates, automation, sending, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Mailercloud account with an encrypted dedicated customer API key. Relay fixes the v1 origin, binds one non-email contact ID and campaign ID, exposes only IDs, timestamps, and campaign lifecycle status, and blocks identity, contact fields, message content, audiences, reports, broader access, exports, and mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERCLOUD_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Mailercloud API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated customer-generated API key; Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the Authorization header to cloudapi.mailercloud.com.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERCLOUD_CONTACT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected non-email contact ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact contact ID whose ID and timestamps Relay may read; email selectors are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERCLOUD_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact campaign whose bounded lifecycle metadata Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected contact summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected contact without identity, email, phone, status, consent, fields, tags, lists, or activity.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded lifecycle metadata for one selected campaign without name, subject, content, sender, audience, reports, or links.

allowed.label: Read selected contact summary
allowed.description: Read the selected contact's ID and timestamps while discarding all personal, preference, list, and engagement fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, status, and timestamps while discarding content, audience, sender, and report details.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Contact identity, email, phone, status, consent, fields, tags, lists, and activity plus campaign name, subject, content, sender, audience, reports, and links are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Mailercloud state
blocked.description: Contacts, lists, tags, campaigns, sends, templates, automation, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Mailercloud access
blocked.description: Other contacts, campaigns, lists, tags, reports, arbitrary paths, queries, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected contact and campaign through an encrypted dedicated API key; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the encrypted dedicated API key server-side and mounts exactly two fixed-v1 projected reads.
Railway stores the encrypted dedicated API key server-side and mounts exactly two fixed-v1 projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A Mailercloud staging account, dedicated API key, exact contact ID, and campaign ID are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console lane must generate a dedicated staging API key, capture it directly in Railway, bind exact non-email contact and campaign IDs, then validate both redacted reads, header/origin containment, email-selector denial, authorization and rate errors, key deletion/replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Mailercloud documents up to ten deletable account API keys, the plain Authorization header, server-only handling without CORS, the fixed cloudapi.mailercloud.com/v1 origin, JSON responses, and request limits.
Mailercloud documents named integration keys, secure handling, and edit/delete lifecycle used for dedicated-key replacement and revocation.
Mailercloud documents the v1 selected contact details read by contact ID or email; Relay fixes the ID path and rejects email selectors.
Mailercloud documents the v1 selected single-campaign details read authenticated with the account API key.
